source: Federal Audit Clearinghouse (api.fac.gov): the single audits filed by bodies in Puerto Rico, their findings and the award lines with a finding
terms: US Government work, public domain (Federal Audit Clearinghouse)

rule.finding: one finding for each audit and reference number, however many award lines it touches
rule.repeat: marked by the auditor as also reported in the audit before
rule.programs: a finding counts once in each program it touches, so programs add up to more than findings
